user.title: Ride Buddy
user.description: This makes a webhook for the Ride Buddy app to send your bikes' details to. With Home Assistant Cloud it works from anywhere; otherwise the phone needs to reach your Home Assistant address. Set-up guide: https://github.com/cyclbatrob/ride-buddy-homeassistant

reconfigure.title: Ride Buddy
reconfigure.description: Shows the webhook address again (it doesn't change).

create_entry.default:
In Ride Buddy, open Settings → Connections → Home Assistant and paste this into Webhook URL:

`{webhook_url}`

Then tap Send test. Each bike appears as a device the first time it sends something.

abort.reconfigure_successful:
Paste this into Ride Buddy's Webhook URL:

`{webhook_url}`
